from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data for a single company from a single report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company as stated in the report")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="Stock code if mentioned in the report")
    operating_revenue: float = Field(description="Operating revenue for the period in Yuan")
    ending_total_assets: float = Field(description="Ending total assets at period end in Yuan")
    reporting_period: str = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the data, e.g., 2025-Q1")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_reports: List[CompanyFinancialRecord] = Field(
        description="Aggregated list of financial records for each document in the collection"
    )
